head: 244b5645c0a566486d142413201ff65300a49bca
summary: The regression proof and all test legs pass, but the candidate is not tidy-clean: ./gradlew tidy reflows the Javadoc in solr/core/src/java/org/apache/solr/response/transform/DocTransformer.java (2 lines changed, formatting only). Per the gate instruction I recorded the drift, restored the exact head, and stopped before Error Prone and the root check rather than claiming a clean exact-head pass. Fail-before is proven on the base with only the candidate test overlaid: the stock test fails at the first loop iteration with related numFound=0, and an isolated committed-only iteration fails the same way because the parent doc lacks the unrequested stored field subject. On the candidate the method passes (1/1), and the six suites run 120 tests with 0 failures, 0 errors, 0 skips.

legs.fail_before_stock: failed as required: base 78404ec8 + candidate TestPseudoReturnFields.java only; testGlobRTGSubqueryUsesUnrequestedStoredField fails on the first loop iteration with related numFound=0 (response has val_i=4 and marker=ok but no subject)
legs.fail_before_committed_only: failed as required: isolated committed=true iteration fails with related numFound=0; request fl=val_*,related:[subquery],marker:[value v=ok] returns no parent subject, so {!terms f=subject v=$row.subject} cannot resolve
legs.pass_after: passed: candidate 244b5645, same command, 1 test / 0 failures / 0 errors / 0 skips; the method asserts both committed=false and committed=true
legs.six_suites: passed: 120 tests, 0 failures, 0 errors, 0 skips; BasicFunctionalityTest 32, TestPseudoReturnFields 37, TestUnifiedSolrHighlighter 33, ReturnFieldsTest 16, TestRetrieveFieldsOptimizer 1, LargeFieldTest 1
legs.targeted_coverage: confirmed in fresh XML: testBatchedGlobRTGAcrossCommittedAndUncommittedDocs, testGlobRTGUncommittedFields, testGlobRTGSubqueryUsesUnrequestedStoredField, testGlobsAndTransformerField, testGlobsAndTransformerFieldRTG, testGlobsRTG, testGlobs
legs.tidy: failed: ./gradlew tidy exit 0 but leaves DocTransformer.java modified (Javadoc line reflow); tracked tree not clean
legs.errorprone: not run: stopped after tidy drift per gate instruction
legs.root_check: not run: stopped after tidy drift per gate instruction

coverage_limits: The stock fail-before aborts on the uncommitted iteration; the committed leg was isolated by changing only the loop array to {true} in the base worktree overlay, then the stock overlay was restored.
Error Prone and the root check did not run because tidy changed tracked source; a repair and a new exact-head gate are required.
